system.description: Requires dust from the Underworld and blood from rare creatures, dried in a jade crucible and ground in a skull-mortar. The thaumaturge eats the mixture and projects a call to the Labyrinth's depths. If successful, a nephwrack is summoned under a Compulsion not to harm the thaumaturge and a Servitude to serve for five days. After five days it may leave or take revenge.
